definition.rho: exact full Cavalar-Oliveira semi-filter cover number using all pairs (E,H)
definition.rho_disj: the same exact full semi-filter obligation universe, but pair candidates are restricted to E intersection H = emptyset

scientific_question: Does allowing nonempty pair intersections strictly reduce exact full-cover cardinality on any graph in a fresh frozen tiny universe, thereby certifying finite operational power that cannot be removed by choosing an equally small all-disjoint cover?

scope.sample_rule: For every 5-edge complement, form canonical sorted-edge string u,v;..., hash SHA256(seed + '|' + canonical_string), sort ascending by digest, take the 64 lowest digests.

chronology.contaminated_prior_task: 4x4 complements with 1<=|U|<=4 were privately inspected before evaluator freeze and are RETROSPECTIVE_CALIBRATION_ONLY
chronology.fresh_task_status: The registered |U|=5 hash sample has not been evaluated before this preregistration.

evaluator.semantic_delta: same relevant semi-filters and Definition-20 predicate; rho_disj rejects candidate pairs with nonempty E&H before mask construction

controls: C008 negative control must return rho=2 and rho_disj=2
restriction monotonicity must hold for every row: rho_disj >= rho
sample manifest reconstructed by evaluator must match the frozen SHA256
all rows and nulls are retained; stopping after first gap is forbidden

outcome_schema.first_strict_gap: first sample-order gap row or null
outcome_schema.output_sha256: SHA256 of canonical output before adding output_sha256

decision_branches.positive: If strict_gap_count>0, retain the first frozen-order witness as finite calibration and open a child atom for a representation-invariant characterization of non-disjoint advantage. Immediately attack amplification with C010/C016.
decision_branches.null: If strict_gap_count=0, record a bounded null only. Do not infer a global disjointization theorem. Lower priority of witness-specific closure-depth ideas and search for richer full-obligation correlations.
decision_branches.invalid: If control, manifest, monotonicity, chronology or evaluator binding fails, classify as tooling/provenance failure and grant no mathematical evidence.

predictions: No directional prediction is used for promotion; either branch is informative.
The C008 negative control is expected to pass from existing C010 evidence.
promotion_blockers: finite computation is not asymptotic proof
